speaker: Guard
content: Good news? Or bad news?

raw: [name="Red"]The good news is that the workshop is still intact, the forest hid it good. The dukes and the Sarkaz never got to use it as an outpost.
speaker: Red
content: The good news is that the workshop is still intact, the forest hid it good. The dukes and the Sarkaz never got to use it as an outpost.

raw: [name="Red"]The bad news is, someone's living there. We saw lights. I walked up, identified myself, and the lights went out.
speaker: Red
content: The bad news is, someone's living there. We saw lights. I walked up, identified myself, and the lights went out.

content: Might be refugees or deserters.

content: But they put out the lights... that means they're wary of us.

speaker: Reunion Warrior
content: Our fighters are ready for anything.

speaker: Nine
content: No, let's not be hasty. They might just be cautious, or fearful.

content: Don't jump to conclusions.

speaker: Guard
content: And anyway, Red's carrying a pretty long blade. Anyone would want to play it safe.

speaker: Guard
content: Why don't I go? I'll have a word with them.

content: By yourself?

raw: [name="Guard"]That's enough. The more men we send, the more nervous they'll be. Besides, if they mean us harm, a few more hands won't make a difference.
speaker: Guard
content: That's enough. The more men we send, the more nervous they'll be. Besides, if they mean us harm, a few more hands won't make a difference.

speaker: Guard

speaker: Guard
content: We need to move fast.

content: There's some risk in that.

speaker: Guard
content: I know.

raw: [name="Guard"]But we made it out of Chernobog.
speaker: Guard
content: But we made it out of Chernobog.

speaker: Nine
content: Fair enough.

raw: [name="Nine"]We'll be ready to provide support on the sidelines, to make a breakthrough.
speaker: Nine
content: We'll be ready to provide support on the sidelines, to make a breakthrough.

speaker: Guard
content: This place was some kind of distillery before the Victorian Reunion settled in?

content: I can already smell the booze. Romanich would've loved it.

text: \nSecret distilleries like this are common enough in Victoria, dodging around punishing taxes imposed by the lords. They could be used to make crude medication for the Infected.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nSoaking, mixing, distilling herbs would work, but purification... no way.",block = true)]
text: \nSoaking, mixing, distilling herbs would work, but purification... no way.

content: Hello. Anybody home?

raw: [name="Guard"]Hi, I'm Guard. I've got a team nearby, I'm pretty sure you saw them earlier?
speaker: Guard
content: Hi, I'm Guard. I've got a team nearby, I'm pretty sure you saw them earlier?

content: Don't worry, we mean no harm.

speaker: Guard
content: The Victorian Reunion used to use this workshop to make medicine.

raw: [name="Guard"]It brought hope to a lot of Infected around Londinium. Its medicine even circulated among the workers in the sewers below the city's industrial districts.
speaker: Guard
content: It brought hope to a lot of Infected around Londinium. Its medicine even circulated among the workers in the sewers below the city's industrial districts.

speaker: Guard
content: Whoever you are, you know the war is turning a lot more people Infected.

content: Since you're occupying the place...

speaker: Guard
content: We need your cooperation.
name: Guard

content: We can provide medicine or other supplies. We'll trade fair.

content: Let's find a place to talk.

content: So you're Reunion, the real Reunion. You came from the north?

content: Yes, Ursus, Columbia, and now we're in Victoria.

content: That's a ways.

content: Your uniform, it's...

content: So you control this place just because you dressed up in the garb of the infamous 'Reunion'.

content: Let's get to the point. I don't have much time.

raw: [name="Mays"]You want to get this place up and running again? To start making medicine?

content: Yes, if news got out that Reunion is running the place again...

content: No.

content: Things are more complicated than you know. We have all kinds of people here.

raw: [name="Mays"]I'm worn out breaking up the daily fights between Infected and uninfected. And you want to make Infected medicine? You might as well blow the place up.

content: I'm worn out breaking up the daily fights between Infected and uninfected. And you want to make Infected medicine? You might as well blow the place up.

content: It's hard to keep a balance between them.

content: You're Reunion, aren't you? At least, you claim to be.

speaker: Mays
content: More or less.

speaker: Guard
content: Who are your people?

speaker: Mays
content: What else would they be? Homeless Infected, war refugees, people who have lost everything. We all need a roof over our heads.

content: I first came here with a few other Infected. We found this ruin.

raw: [name="Mays"]Later, more people came, including some... less than honest folk. We don't take anyone else in anymore.
speaker: Mays
content: Later, more people came, including some... less than honest folk. We don't take anyone else in anymore.

raw: [name="Mays"]I'm glad to see you, Reunion comrades, but I don't want to worry anyone here.
speaker: Mays
content: I'm glad to see you, Reunion comrades, but I don't want to worry anyone here.

speaker: Guard
content: Worry?

raw: [name="Mays"]That you're conspiring with us to wipe out the uninfected in our midst.
speaker: Mays
content: That you're conspiring with us to wipe out the uninfected in our midst.

raw: [name="Mays"]Whether or not it's just a pretext to get us to open our doors to you, we can trade supplies. But let's leave it at that...

content: Whether or not it's just a pretext to get us to open our doors to you, we can trade supplies. But let's leave it at that...

speaker: Guard
content: There are plenty of uninfected here, so I get what you're saying.

raw: [name="Guard"]But I still think it would be a good idea to talk it over with your people before you come to a decision. As long as we can get back to making medicine here, we can come to a long-term agreement—

content: But I still think it would be a good idea to talk it over with your people before you come to a decision. As long as we can get back to making medicine here, we can come to a long-term agreement—

content: No, no thank you.

raw: [name="Mays"]Now, off with you. It was nice meeting you.
speaker: Mays
content: Now, off with you. It was nice meeting you.

raw: [name="Mays"]If you want to take this place, you're welcome to it. So long as you can take it.
speaker: Mays
content: If you want to take this place, you're welcome to it. So long as you can take it.

content: I've heard... from the passing caravans, I've heard it's a nice place.
